violation_type.title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §747.3935(b))
violation_type.typical_finding: The permit holder has not completed the annual certification.

finding_variants.text: The permit holder has not completed the annual certification.
The required Consumer Product Safety Commission form has not been completed within the last year.
The children's product form has not been re-certified.
There was not an updated children's product certification available for licensing to review.
The provider had not yet updated the CPSC form at the time of the follow up inspection.
